title: Misleading You only get one and nt 2 as stated, so only half the stars for a half-fulfilled order
text: Misleading You only get one and nt 2 as stated, so only half the stars for a half-fulfilled order. The material is very thin, which is fine with me, but I only got one when the description stated 2. I called Amazon who promptly sent me anther order and it only contained one too. I'm fine with 2 total now, but you won't be when they only send one to you too. It was a cheap product I only needed to keep my clothes clean, and it serves its purpose.  Excellent in the summertime as its sheer and won't add to your body heat.
